groot.name: Ironwood Guard
groot.description: Gains 4 maximum health and reduces every incoming hit by 1.

hulk.name: Worldbreaker
hulk.description: Gains 4 power and restores 3 health after knocking out an enemy.

iron-man.name: Maximum Pulse
iron-man.description: Gains 18% critical chance and critical hits deal 3 additional damage.

spider-man.name: Spider-Sense
spider-man.description: Has a 22% chance to dodge attacks and deals 3 bonus damage to enemies at or below 35% health.

thor.name: God of Thunder
thor.description: His first strike deals 5 bonus damage and he gains 18% critical chance.

bastion.name: Configuration: Assault
bastion.description: Gains 2 power and reduces every incoming hit by 1.

genji.name: Deflect
genji.description: Has an 18% chance to dodge and reflects 2 damage whenever struck.

junkrat.name: Total Mayhem
junkrat.description: Returns 3 explosive damage whenever an enemy lands a hit.

roadhog.name: Take a Breather
roadhog.description: Gains 3 maximum health and heals for 35% of damage dealt.

tracer.name: Blink Recall
tracer.description: Has a 18% chance to dodge and deals 2 bonus damage on her first strike.

bomb-king.name: Royal Detonation
bomb-king.description: Gains 20% critical chance and critical hits deal 4 additional damage.

drogoz.name: Dragon Punch
drogoz.description: His opening attack deals 6 bonus damage.

moji.name: Familiar Feast
moji.description: Deals 8 bonus damage to enemies at or below 50% health.

raum.name: Soul Armor
raum.description: Gains 5 maximum health and heals for 25% of damage dealt.

seris.name: Soul Collector
seris.description: Heals for 45% of damage dealt and restores 3 more health after a knockout.
